title: On $\textbf{u}$-substitutions for group presentations
summary: We investigate groups $\hat{G}$ given by a presentation $\mathcal{P}=\langle \textbf{x}: \textbf{r} \rangle$ whose relators $\textbf{r} \subseteq F(\textbf{x})$ are comprised of a set of subwords in $F(\textbf{x})$, i.e. $\textbf{r}$ admits a $\textbf{u}$-substitution in the sense that there exists a homomorphsim $ε: F(\textbf{u}) \rightarrow F(\textbf{x})$ and a subset $\mathbf{v} \subseteq F(\textbf{u})$ such that $\textbf{r}=ε(\textbf{v})$.
